appDescription: DAON (다온, '다녀간 곳에 온기를 남기다') lets a family or friends group leave a few warm words at a place or a driving moment. The words are played back later in the other members' cars when they pass that place or meet that moment.

function.name: SAVE_SPOT
function.description: Mark the car's current location as a temporary DAON spot for one of the driver's groups, such as family or friends, so the driver can leave warm words there after parking.

memo.description: Optional short label for the spot in the driver's own words.

group.description: The group this spot is for, as the driver said it: a group type such as family, friends or couple, or the group's name. Omit to use the current group.

function.name: LEAVE_DAON
function.description: Leave a few warm DAON words for one of the driver's groups, such as family or friends, at the current place or a driving moment, to be played back later in the other members' cars.

text.description: The words as the listeners will hear them: one short natural sentence spoken directly to them in the driver's own tone, without request words or the app name.

group.description: The group these words are for, as the driver said it: a group type such as family, friends or couple, or the group's name. Omit to use the current group.

when.description: When the words are played back: place = passing the current location (default), rain = rainy day, night = night drive, together = someone in the passenger seat, door = getting in the car, start = starting the car, park = parking at the current location, long = long drive, region = entering the current region, warning = a warning light turns on.

useSavedSpot.description: True to leave the words at the spot saved most recently instead of the current location.

function.name: UNDO_SPOT
function.description: Delete the temporary DAON spot the driver marked most recently.
